caption: Overlap matrix of the 69 simulated error-free reads that start in the first 1500 bases of phiX174, sorted by their true start. Entry (i, j) is the longest suffix of read i that equals a prefix of read j (minimum overlap 9); white means no overlap. The band lies above the diagonal only: overlaps are directional, ov(i, j) is not ov(j, i).
